description: Invites a person by email to work in this PostWire workspace with a role: admin (Everything except billing and ownership: members, brands, connections, approval rules, keys); editor (Writes, schedules and publishes posts, within each brand's approval rules); contributor (Drafts and schedules posts; every one waits for approval before it goes out); approver (Only the approvals inbox: sees the previews, approves or rejects); viewer (Read-only: sees posts, the queue, accounts and activity). Editors, contributors, approvers and viewers can be limited to some brands (brand_ids). Seats are members plus open invitations; the plan sets how many. For safety only a person signed in to the PostWire dashboard can add people: from an AI assistant or an API key nothing is sent, and the result gives instead the seats free on the plan (or, when they are all in use, the plan with more seats, its price and a checkout link), the dashboard link and the steps (Settings, Team) with this email and role, for the person to send it there.

brand_ids.description: Only these brands (editor, contributor, approver, viewer). Omit for every brand.
